object.attr: derived: CF-V8 (D-V6). Mellon commits working-copy bytes without running the filter, which bypasses LFS and similar conventions. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V12), to confirm; the USAGE.md note that LFS isn't supported in document folders is handed to Process.
object.description: If git applies a filter other than line-ending conversion to a selected path, Mellon shall refuse the commit and name the path and the filter.
